$comment: PROPOSED format (SCH-007): not a frozen standard. It describes config.toml through the JSON data model of TOML (as used by TOML editors). The Rust parser in crates/glint-schema (src/config.rs) is authoritative where this schema and the parser disagree; tests keep the key sets aligned. Every key is optional in a user config.toml; the bundled config/default.toml must set all of them. Unknown keys are rejected in [packages], [security], [registries.<name>], at the top level and as unknown tables, and ignored with warning GLINT_CONFIG_WARN_UNKNOWN_FIELD in [app], [registry], [theme] and [shell]. Merge policy: bundled defaults < user config (keys override one by one, registries merge by name); settings requested by a package are never applied. See docs/architecture/application-config.md.
title: Glint application configuration (config.toml) v1
description: Configures the Glint application. Distinct from the registry index, theme manifests (glint.json) and profiles (profile.json).

locale.description: "system" or a language tag such as en-GB.

cache_ttl.description: Index cache lifetime: a whole number and s, m, h or d, at most 365d.

registries.description: Named registries. A user entry with an existing name changes only the fields it sets; a new name must set type and url.

url.description: https URL of the index, without credentials, query or fragment. It is the registry's package origin (ADR 0006).

branch.description: Branch to read; absent means the repository's default branch.

auto_update.description: Install updates without asking. Security: false is safe.

preview_before_apply.description: Preview a theme before applying it. Security: true is safe.

allow_external_git.description: Allow installs from arbitrary Git repositories. Security: false is safer.

allow_local_archives.description: Allow importing local .glint files. Security: false is safer.

verify_integrity.description: Verify package digests. Security: true is safe.

allow_native_scripts.description: Allow package-supplied native scripts. Security: false is safe.

confirm_new_permissions.description: Ask before granting new permissions. Security: true is safe.

untrusted_network_default.description: Default network decision for untrusted content, safest first.

use_default_fallback.description: Fall back to the default theme when a surface fails. Security: true is safe.

safe_mode_after_crashes.description: Crashes before safe mode starts. Security: lower is safer.
